recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining source defect tied to FHIR-51148 without adding speculative new examples or deciding the separate doNotPerform/intent trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-51148 was an Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for R6 asking to add AllergyIntolerance as an allowed MedicationRequest.reason reference target and include clinical examples using AllergyIntolerance as a reason for doNotPerform or alternative medication requests.
initial_application: The structural change had already been applied by d86923e778, which added AllergyIntolerance to MedicationRequest.reason.targetProfile. The examples had already been added by 7d10e89f2c and merged through HL7/fhir#3896, but medicationrequest0350 still used the retired reasonCode element and an invalid Coding.text child.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationRequest as an active resource with approved maturity metadata, so source/medicationrequest changes are current-build scope. Pharmacy Confluence notes from 2025-06-19 and 2025-06-30 support AllergyIntolerance references and use of .reason text for alternative therapy while leaving broader premedication/alternative-therapy intent modeling as separate work. No Zulip discussion was found that changed this conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0350.xml so the alternative-therapy text is represented as reason.concept.text and the actual indication coding uses Coding.display. The existing AllergyIntolerance targetProfile and example list entries were left intact.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0350.xml: replaced retired reasonCode with reason.concept.text for the alternative-therapy reason.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0350.xml: replaced invalid Coding.text with Coding.display for the SNOMED actual-indication coding and normalized the surrounding reason block indentation.

related_jiras.note: Confirmed MedicationRequest.reason is the intended place for doNotPerform reasons, but its broader doNotPerform wording/example scope was not independently decided by this seed reconciliation.
